how: Members recruited hands to start the figure, sustain slow work, and finish its logo.
Members acknowledged that small numbers made progress slow and moving difficult.
A member proposed the shared figure, fitting the revised starter role without requiring evidence of who joined.
Starting and calling can coincide in one utterance rather than occurring as separately observable stages.
A proposed yellow background received a bare assent asking for nothing back.
The visible bare assent answers a design proposal rather than establishing the specific mobilisation-call acceptance mechanism.
The recruitment call precedes a progress report without identifying which builders the call brought to the canvas.
Explaining the game to a passer-by does not establish a question or explanation about canvas rules, controls, or pictured events.
A shouted request to stop changing a reference identifies frustration but not a departing member or repaired interpersonal quarrel.
Members expanded the design into a subreddit reference, a skull, and a skeleton.
A public report described the figure as halfway done.
Members made the design workable through outline directions, pixel corrections, a grid request, and a gridded reference.
A posted template settles design only when participants can stabilise its reference rather than repeatedly changing it.
Builders keep a reference usable through correction and explicit requests to stop changing it.
Complicated art work prompted an art-specific chat, invitations to discuss there, and later directions to obtain relocation updates there.
Moving live discussion to chat can coexist with continuing public corrections and requests rather than replacing thread coordination entirely.
One room cannot test the population frequency, while visible instructions establish neither formal appointment nor its absence.
A manual placing-rate report does not establish or exclude machine placing in unrecorded venues.
Slow placing alone does not establish constraints from members fitting work around sleep, study, employment, travel, or devices.
Refreshing revealed collective completion to a member who thought they were placing alone, showing an updated view without proving a platform fault.
Contacting another administrator in chat establishes diplomacy rather than concealment, infiltration, or spying.
Participants deferred some repairs, reverted overwrites, removed noise, and rallied to repair damaged parts.
The placed foot was already something to keep while members were still finishing the face.
The revised clause about uninformed keepers undoing agreed changes and causing loss remains unverified despite missed communication and attempts to tell overwriters.
An outside participant reported repairing the art and privately sending the plan to people placing grey pixels.
A neighbour explained an unintended overlap, while an apology attributed other damage to someone missing the agreement.
Repeated repair and repair appeals do not demonstrate a resulting turn to scripts or spare accounts.
Participants proposed moving a neighbouring name below the sign and permitted a sun beam behind their art.
Members refused expansion that would demolish existing art and apologised for damage despite an agreement.
An apology explicitly invoked the agreement to leave neighbouring lettering alone as the standard that should have been kept.
Neighbour relations included requests, offers, greetings, and construction help promised in return for moving a name.
An offer to move a neighbouring name was answered by agreement and a promise of construction help.
A participant described neighbouring groups as allies available for help if moving became difficult.
A member reported contacting an outside administrator about relocation without establishing authority to bind all placers.
Members proposed an early shift around obstructing text and later chose preventive movement to avoid threatened total overwrite.
Preventive relocation includes pausing old-site maintenance and restarting construction at a destination located against a fixed landmark.
The relocation episode returns to building when a participant reports that the new figure has started at the destination.
Participants explain preventive movement through relative numerical weakness and the expected risk of defending current ground.
The retained concepts establish threatened total overwrite and preventive movement rather than a move contingent on an already erased work.
Numerical weakness supports the preventive-move explanation but does not establish the arrow into post-loss relocation.
Earlier overwrites and later neighbour negotiations do not identify the same counterpart or establish the specified causal chain.
Promised external assistance remains distinct from completed assistance when the returning report explicitly warns that the promise may be untrue.
Suggested outside help does not establish that upkeep strain caused another room to supply it.
Reported alliances and possible assistance do not establish that shared maintenance strain caused coalition formation and fulfilled mutual defence.
Someone missing an agreement does not establish an explicit limit on commitment, rejection of authority, or refusal to be bound.
The neighbouring-name agreement and apology supply no observed statement of commitment limits or refusal after an agreement.
A surviving title asks permission to build beside the skull, fitting the request end of hosting without demonstrating permission granted.
An individual contributing to the void does not establish dual room membership or a group response to divided loyalty.
Refusing destructive expansion and reporting another group's unhappiness do not establish a reciprocal argument over the fairness of covering art.
A participant carried the rhythm game's shared language into placing by describing pixels per musical beat.
A neighbouring name became a recurring canvas joke and received a promise to retain a one-pixel remnant after relocation.
Naming a political subreddit does not establish a quarrel carried into the event from before it.
A report about somebody else's planned attack does not establish prior ties motivating an attack by this room.
Creating an art-specific chat within an established subreddit does not establish a new autonomous room forming around a mark.
A game-music criticism and defensive reply do not establish a dispute over offensive words or symbols.
The room staged game jokes, including a false completion claim challenged and explicitly explained as a joke.
Moving live discussion to an art chat does not establish host posting rules, removals, or objections to a canvas flood.
The recruitment call and chat move do not establish a flood of canvas posts causing host regulation.
A venue change and a visitor's music criticism do not establish an attack on the mark caused by objections to its posts.
Participants celebrated completed parts, claimed small contributions, thanked makers, and described shared completion as bittersweet.
The progress report and later completion announcement support a local building-to-celebration sequence without demonstrating every placer's response.
A participant recorded the claimed post-event survival of the art in the final screenshot.
An atlas referral supports an invitation toward documentation rather than a completed entry when its quoted span contains only a link cue.
An ending added to an edited opening post cannot be dated from that post's original creation time.
Separate celebration and documentation references do not establish causation, particularly where the ending appears in an undated edit.
A visitor explicitly attributed finding the subreddit to its canvas work without establishing lasting membership or a measured influx.
A member explained the game's genre to a passer-by in the canvas celebration thread.

statement: Carrying a visitor's game criticism into ordinary subreddit argument
how: A visitor's music challenge elicited a defensive reply, adding ordinary game disagreement to the room's canvas encounters.
Recognition of a musician's help and a later greeting do not establish outward outreach or that the greeting acknowledged the artwork itself.
Accepting an imperfect skeleton in the final screenshot does not establish correction of an event account or a contest over its preserved version.
Post-event thanks and a documentation referral do not establish a decision to continue or repurpose the organising effort.
A survival record and atlas referral show no observed transition into a decision to continue the temporary effort.
A member's separate void contribution and a report about another group's attack do not establish this room collectively attacking a rival.
A music critic and defensive reply do not establish a contest between rival canvas rooms.
Recruitment and separate individual void participation do not establish the room's call turning into an attack.
Refusal of destructive expansion is visible without an attack call shown to have elicited it.
Neighbour accommodation cannot be attributed to an unobserved attack call.
Reported overwrites and defensive visitor talk do not establish an attack by this room causing a rival-room contest.
